verdict.rationale: The evidence shows first-party Microsoft Graph API reference pages for OneDrive endpoints, such as driveItem addressing, createLink, search, delta, upload sessions and put-content. Nothing in the pack shows that these pages are interactive or offer runnable in-browser examples, and probes found no OpenAPI or swagger spec at the docs host that would power such tooling. missing for 10: an interactive explorer/try-it console, runnable examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
